build_TranslationLevenshteinTask: build a Levenshtein Transformer translation task that extends fairseq TranslationTask with noise injection
inject_noise_random_delete: inject random delete noise into target tokens by randomly removing tokens while preserving bos and eos
inject_noise_random_mask: inject random mask noise into target tokens by replacing random tokens with the unk token
build_IterativeRefinementGenerator: build an IterativeRefinementGenerator for decoding with configurable beam size, max iterations, and adaptive mode
run_train_step: run a training step that injects noise into target tokens and computes loss with backward pass
